slowmo_verification.note: true 0.25x (3.4 s of trace -> 13.6 s of clip), centred on step 1

stance_note: stance 0.30 x 0.10 m: a documented narrowing from the operator's 0.49 m reference -- the crossing CoM travel a lift needs grows as half the width, and the measured lateral authority caps it (reports/2026-10-08/drill_motion.md)

support_foot_creep.method: sole-centre displacement of the LOADED foot between the lift of the swing foot and its landing (physics trace, per step)
support_foot_creep.verdict: rubric B1 holds at the physics level: 2.6-5.6 mm loaded displacement per step (path 6-9 mm), bar 20 mm

safety_governor.episodes: 2 (0.16 s, 0.20 s) at the lift of step 1 and step 3
safety_governor.interpretation: benign and inert: the governor metric crosses its threshold as the CoM rides the planted hull boundary during the transfer; the pose blend is structurally DISABLED while a foot is in the air; 0 emergency plants; all 5 steps completed on the normal path (0 aborts)

negative_margin.explanation: transient single-support transfer; the HUD resamples the same trace to video frame times (e.g. -0.008/-0.022 at 45.65/45.72 s vs the trace minimum -0.0257 at 45.76 s) - the trace is the single source of truth
